description: New pages: Transfers, Receiving, Adjustments, LowStock - all with dark glassmorphism theme, motion animations, and full UI implementation including dialogs, tables, and status badges
steps: Create src/pages/inventory/Transfers.tsx (default export): Full transfer management page with motion/react animations. PageHeader with title 'Transfers' and 'New Transfer' button. DataTable showing all transfers with columns: transfer_number, source warehouse, destination warehouse, status (color-coded Badge - pending=yellow, approved=blue, in_transit=purple, completed=green, rejected=red), requested date, items count. Status filter using Select component. 'New Transfer' Dialog (multi-step): Step 1 select source warehouse, Step 2 select destination warehouse, Step 3 add products with quantities (searchable product select + qty input, add/remove rows), Step 4 notes + submit. Transfer detail expandable/dialog showing: transfer number, status, dates, source->dest, items table, approval action buttons (Approve/Reject if pending), timeline of status changes. Use stepper/progress bar for status flow visualization. Include loading skeletons via Skeleton component, EmptyState for no transfers, toast (sonner) for mutations.

Create src/pages/inventory/Receiving.tsx (default export): PO receiving page with motion animations. PageHeader 'Receiving'. Two sections: 'Pending POs' list and 'GRN History' (tabs). Pending POs: Card list of POs with status confirmed/partially_received showing PO number, supplier name, items count, progress bar showing % received. 'Receive Items' button per PO opens Dialog: shows all PO line items table with columns (product name, ordered qty, already received qty, remaining qty, input field for qty to receive now, optional rejection qty + reason, optional batch number, optional expiry date). Top fields: supplier invoice number, notes. Submit creates GRN + movements. GRN History tab: DataTable of all GRNs with grn_number, PO reference, received_by, date, items count. Include loading skeletons and empty states.

Create src/pages/inventory/Adjustments.tsx (default export): Stock adjustment page with motion animations. PageHeader 'Stock Adjustments' with 'New Adjustment' button. Dialog for new adjustment: select warehouse (Select), select product (searchable Command/combobox), display current stock (read-only card), adjustment type toggle (Add/Remove), quantity input, reason dropdown (from useAdjustmentReasons hook), notes textarea (required if reason='other'), submit button. History DataTable with columns: date, product, warehouse, reason badge, quantity (+/- colored), user. Filters: warehouse select, product search, reason select, date range. Include skeletons and empty states.

Create src/pages/inventory/LowStock.tsx (default export): Low stock alerts dashboard with motion animations. Summary stats row at top using KPICard pattern: total alerts count, critical count (below min_stock), out of stock count (qty=0), estimated reorder value. Grid of product alert cards below, each card (glass bg, rounded-[24px]) showing: product name, SKU, current stock (large number, color-coded: amber if below reorder, red if below min, destructive if 0), reorder point, min stock level, progress bar (current/max). Quick action buttons per card: 'Create PO' (links to /procurement/orders), 'Dismiss'. Filters: severity (all/critical/warning/out-of-stock). Include loading skeleton grid and empty state.
acceptance_criteria: All four page files exist at src/pages/inventory/ with default exports
Each page uses motion/react for entry animations
Dark glassmorphism theme applied consistently: glass cards, primary=#10b981, rounded corners
Status badges color-coded: pending=yellow/amber, approved=blue, in_transit=purple, completed=green, rejected=red
Dialog components used for forms (not separate pages)
Loading skeletons shown during data fetches
Empty states with icons shown when no data
bun run type-check passes with zero errors
findings: All four pages created with mock data, motion animations, dialog forms, status badges, DataTable usage, and glassmorphism styling. The pages use mutation hooks for form submissions (useCreateTransfer, useReceiveItems, useCreateAdjustment, useDismissAlert). Fixed unused imports (ArrowRight, Progress, Textarea) and typed IconMap explicitly to satisfy strict TS. Build and type-check pass cleanly.
